section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch47 — Modern India — Deep Practice
subject: Social Studies
stem: Raja Ram Mohan Roy's campaign led to the legal abolition of which social evil in 1829?
explanation: Ram Mohan Roy's sustained campaign led Governor-General Bentinck to abolish Sati in 1829.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch50 — Civics — Deep Practice
subject: Social Studies
stem: The power of the Supreme Court and High Courts to examine the constitutional validity of laws is known as:
explanation: Judicial Review is the constitutional power to strike down laws/executive acts inconsistent with the Constitution.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch48 — World Geography — Deep Practice
subject: Social Studies
stem: Which is the largest continent by both area and population?
explanation: Asia is the largest continent by both area and population. Africa is the second-largest by area.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch51 — Economics — Deep Practice
subject: Social Studies
stem: Agriculture, fishing and mining together belong to which sector of the economy?
explanation: The primary sector directly draws from nature. The secondary sector processes/manufactures raw materials; the tertiary sector provides services.
